svg.title: Zheng He: Ming crane
svg.desc: Period motif. A flying crane with a long curved neck, swept feather fan and trailing legs draws on the first-rank civil official’s bird insignia used under the Ming. It represents courtly distinction and cultural prestige; it is not a claim about Zheng He’s own rank badge or an attested Ming naval flag. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
